messages:
marta (marketing): quick check — Aster Labs agreed to an interview for a customer story. can we lock a 30-min slot next week? they want to highlight latency wins and cost delta. :wave:
liam (producer): great — would prefer a recorded 30-min convo + 10-min product demo. i'm free tues/wed mornings. sending calendar options in a sec. :calendar:
calendar-bot: Proposed slots: Tue 9:30-10:00, Tue 11:00-11:30, Wed 9:00-9:30 — use link to claim slot: https://cal.example/s/aster-advocate 
liam (producer): pasted link ^ please pick one, i'll send Zoom invite and recording consent form.
sophie (ae): i'll introduce and run the interview. can someone confirm two hero metrics to ask for? we want a quote + a short numeric stat.
jason (product): suggest asking for: 1) 95th pct latency change in production for their main flow, 2) token cost per inference before/after (approx). example phrasing: "we saw ~40% lower per-token cost after moving to X"
marta (marketing): yup — those numbers. also please ask for an out-of-the-box quote we can use in the blog + tweet. get verbatim permission for a 1-2 sentence pull quote.
tom (legal): heads-up — we'll need signed release + optional redaction window. liam, can you attach the standard release (v2) and add the checkbox for anonymization? mark as required before publishing. :lock:
liam (producer): will attach. suggested release checklist:
```
- release form (v2) signed
- hero quote approved in writing
- data points confirmed + source (screenshot ok)
- embargo date (if any)
- recording transcript to be shared for redlines
```

nina (cs): also, route inbound leads from the post to AE queue. once published, can marketing push a short handoff with the playbook? Sophie's team will need lead tags: "case-study-aster" + "high-touch".
sophie (ae): noted — will set up lead routing rule. who owns producing a 2-line case blurb for sales enablement?
marta (marketing): i'll draft the blurb and the social copy after the interview. liam — can you record a raw cut and drop into /marketing/assets/case-studies/aster when done? mark with timestamped quotes.
liam (producer): yes. recording details: Zoom record to cloud, auto-transcribe, share transcript via Drive. i'll add a step for transcript redline: customer has 48 hours to request edits, legal approves final edits.
tom (legal): 48h window is fine. for any edits that change meaning we need a signed addendum.
sophie (ae): one ask for the call — can we get a quick slide with their before/after numbers? even a screenshot of their internal dashboard is fine (they offered). i'll request in the calendar invite.
marta (marketing): perfect. once we have signed release + hero quote, i'll route to comms and announce a soft embargo if they request. otherwise target publish T+2 weeks from interview.
liam (producer): slot claimed: Tue 11:00-11:30 by Aster. sending invites now.
sophie (ae): thanks — i'll prep questions and send a 2-question pre-read: 1) top KPI improvements, 2) favorite feature + one sentence on dev experience.
marta (marketing): awesome — i'll add social hooks and a suggested tweet. will loop legal if anything unusual comes up. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Event created: Aster Labs — Case Story Interview — Tue 11:00-11:30 (Zoom)."
